    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    slug      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    stream_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES streams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "DB='assets/data/career_path.db'
ids='2,3,21,24,25,42,43,46,66,67,68,70,71,72,73,90,153,155,198,247,272,275,278,281,283,285,288,340,341,342,348,349,345,346,337,335,336,21,9'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -separator "'$'"'\\t' \""'$DB" "WITH RECURSIVE chain(id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id,depth,root) AS (SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id,0,id FROM career_nodes WHERE id IN ($ids) UNION ALL SELECT p.id,p.slug,p.name,p.parent_id,p.stream_id,c.depth+1,c.root FROM career_nodes p JOIN chain c ON c.parent_id=p.id) SELECT root AS selected_id, group_concat(name,'"' > ') AS breadcrumb FROM (SELECT root,name,depth FROM chain UNION ALL SELECT c.id,s.name,-1 FROM career_nodes c JOIN streams s ON s.id=c.stream_id WHERE c.id IN ("'$ids)) GROUP BY root ORDER BY root;"
printf '"'\\nParent rows:\\n'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -column \""'$DB" "SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id FROM career_nodes WHERE id IN ($ids) ORDER BY id;"'

/bin/bash -lc "DB='assets/data/career_path.db'
ids='2,3,21,24,25,42,43,46,66,67,68,70,71,72,73,90,153,155,198,247,272,275,278,281,283,285,288,340,341,342,348,349,345,346,337,335,336,21,9'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -separator "'$'"'\\t' \""'$DB" "WITH RECURSIVE chain(id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id,depth,root) AS (SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id,0,id FROM career_nodes WHERE id IN ($ids) UNION ALL SELECT p.id,p.slug,p.name,p.parent_id,p.stream_id,c.depth+1,c.root FROM career_nodes p JOIN chain c ON c.parent_id=p.id) SELECT root AS selected_id, group_concat(name,'"' > ') AS breadcrumb FROM (SELECT root,name,depth FROM chain UNION ALL SELECT c.id,s.name,-1 FROM career_nodes c JOIN streams s ON s.id=c.stream_id WHERE c.id IN ("'$ids)) GROUP BY root ORDER BY root;"
printf '"'\\nParent rows:\\n'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -column \""'$DB" "SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id FROM career_nodes WHERE id IN ($ids) ORDER BY id;"'
